notes.title: Seduction Has Been Updated!
notes.content:
Hello!

We've made some improvements and bug fixes to the game.

List of changes:

Oculus support is now working as intended
Added music and ambient sounds to all stages
Fixed orb picking bug
Fixed girls sounds on Oculus
Fixed problem with menu button on few stages
Other minor bug fixes


Thank you for all your support!

notes.title: Oculus Support
notes.content:
We are aware of the problem on Oculus Rift with Touch controllers.

Until we resolve it, here is temporary fix:

Change Seduction file to Windows 7 compatibility mode (picture below).
To do so, locate the game .exe file on your computer, usually it looks something like this: 
Local Disk (D:)/Steam/steamapps/common/Seduction

Press right mouse button on it and select Properties.

Choose Compatibility tab

Check the box next to 'Run this program in compatibility mode for:' and select Windows 7 below.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29536820/8c9a10709bbbf906ce765f7ddd598513a855dbf9.jpg

We will fix it as soon as possible. Sorry for the inconvenience.
